title: Pipeline or notebook: choose the tool for each scenario
objective_text: Choose between a pipeline, a Copy job, a notebook and a Spark job definition for five loading and orchestration scenarios, and say why.
scenario: Harbourline's data team has five jobs to build this quarter, from a petabyte migration to a stream that must keep running. Each needs the right tool.
verifies: You can pick the right tool or store for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can build it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
review_notes: Every claim was checked against its source page on 2026-11-06.
